summary: The Enumeration derive generates a TryFrom<i32> return type using Self::Error, which becomes ambiguous when the enum has an Error variant. The fix explicitly names ::prost::UnknownEnumValue. The fix adds FEEDING_ERROR to the existing enum_keyword_variant.proto fixture, included by the module containing enum_keyword_variant::dummy. This regression check detects the bug during compilation; the empty test body cannot fail at runtime. Consequently, the expected compilation failure cannot satisfy the reproduction contract's requirement that the buggy test target builds and executes a failing test.
